question: Which property changes the background color of an element?
explanation: background-color sets the background. color only changes the text color.

question: Which property sets the size of text?
explanation: font-size controls how big the text is, for example font-size: 18px.

question: How do you select all elements with class="card"?
explanation: A dot selects by class. A hash (#) selects by id, and a plain name selects by tag.

question: Which property adds space inside an element, between its content and its border?
explanation: padding is the inner space. margin is the outer space around the border.

question: Which property makes text bold?
explanation: font-weight: bold (or 700) makes text bold. font-style is for italic.

question: How do you write a comment in CSS?
explanation: CSS only supports /* comment */. The other styles belong to JavaScript, HTML or other languages.

question: Which value hides an element and removes the space it takes?
explanation: display: none removes the element from the layout. visibility: hidden and opacity: 0 hide it but keep its space.

question: Which property centers text horizontally inside its block?
explanation: text-align: center centers inline content such as text inside a block element.

question: What does the gap property do in Flexbox and Grid?
explanation: gap sets the space between flex or grid items without adding margins to each item.

question: Which unit is relative to the root (html) font size?
explanation: rem means root em. 1rem equals the font size of the html element, usually 16px.

question: Which pseudo-class styles an element when the mouse is over it?
explanation: :hover applies while the pointer is over the element. :focus applies when it has keyboard focus.

question: Which position value keeps an element in the same place on the screen while scrolling?
explanation: position: fixed places the element relative to the viewport, so it does not move when the page scrolls.

question: What does flex-direction: column do?
explanation: column makes the main axis vertical, so flex items stack from top to bottom.

question: Which property controls which positioned element appears on top?
explanation: z-index sets the stacking order of positioned elements. Higher values appear in front.

question: What does 1fr mean in CSS Grid?
options: One fraction of the free space
explanation: fr is a fraction unit. grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr gives the second column twice the free space.

question: Which rule applies styles only on screens 600px wide or smaller?
explanation: max-width: 600px matches viewports up to 600px. min-width matches 600px and wider.

question: An element with position: absolute is placed relative to what?
explanation: It uses the nearest ancestor with a position other than static. If there is none, it uses the initial containing block.

question:
Which selector matches a

that comes immediately after an

?
explanation: + is the adjacent sibling combinator. ~ matches any following sibling, > matches direct children.

question: The html font size is 16px and a parent has font-size: 20px. How big is font-size: 2em on its child?
explanation: For font-size, em is relative to the parent font size: 2 × 20px = 40px. 2rem would be 32px.

question: What are values like --primary: #4f46e5 called in plain CSS?
explanation: They are custom properties (CSS variables). You read them with var(--primary), and they can change at runtime.

question: What does the :not() pseudo-class do?
options: Selects elements that do not match the given selector
Removes an element from the page
explanation: For example, button:not(:disabled) matches every button that is not disabled.

question: Three .child elements are inside .parent. How is the free width shared?
options: Each child gets an equal share of the free space
The first child takes all the space
Children keep only their content width
explanation: flex: 1 sets flex-grow to 1 on every child, so the free space is split equally between them.
